description: Expand test coverage for critical paths: Add missing tests for auth flows, lead workflows, call handling, distribution engine, and automation. Fix existing test failures after FEAT-001 changes.
steps: Run npm run test to establish baseline pass rate after FEAT-001 TypeScript fixes.

Audit existing test coverage: tests/ has unit tests (date-range, distribution-engine, import-mapping, lead-query, password, rbac, scope, telephony, workspace) and integration tests (concurrency, telephony, workspace). Coverage unknown - no coverage reporter configured.
Add vitest coverage reporter: Install @vitest/coverage-v8, add coverage config to package.json script, set coverage thresholds (statements: 60%, branches: 50%, functions: 60% as initial targets).
Add missing auth tests: tests/auth.test.ts covering login with locked account, password reset flow, session expiry, must-change-password redirect.
Add lead workflow tests: tests/lead-workflow.test.ts covering create → assign → call → follow-up → convert end-to-end flow.

Add distribution tests: Expand tests/distribution-engine.test.ts to cover all assignment methods (round-robin, equal, workload, campaign, location, manual), approval workflows, daily limits, max active leads.
Add call handling tests: tests/call-handling.test.ts covering startCall idempotency, completeCall transactions, disposition logic, recording access permissions.
Add automation tests: tests/automation.test.ts covering each trigger type, condition matching, action execution, deduplication via dedupeKey.
Add report generation tests: tests/reports.test.ts covering CSV/Excel/PDF export, grouping (day/week/month), data accuracy for each report type.
Fix integration tests after rate-limit API changes (already covered in FEAT-001 but verify they run clean).
Run npm run test:all (unit + integration) and achieve >60% statement coverage on critical paths (services/, lib/auth/, lib/distribution/).
acceptance_criteria: npm run test passes with 0 failures
npm run test:integration passes with 0 failures
Code coverage report generated and shows ≥60% statement coverage for services/ and lib/
Critical paths have explicit test coverage: login, lead create/assign, call complete, distribution rules, automation triggers
All new tests follow existing patterns in tests/helpers.ts for database setup/teardown
verification: npm run test -- --coverage to generate coverage report
Verify coverage/index.html shows ≥60% for services/, lib/auth/, lib/distribution/
npm run test:all to run both unit and integration suites
Review coverage report for untested critical paths and document as known limitations if not covered
findings: Test suite exists with good foundation (12 test files) but coverage unknown. No coverage reporter configured. Critical gaps: auth flows (only password.test.ts), lead workflows (only query tests), call handling (only telephony provider tests, not service layer), automation (no tests found), reports (no tests). Integration tests cover concurrency and telephony but not end-to-end user journeys. tests/phases-9-12.test.ts has rate limit tests needing fixes from FEAT-001.
